WITHOUT SKILL: Responses are generic but highly competent — cover all the same debugging concepts with excellent code examples, but use generic patterns rather than project-specific references. Faster and more token-efficient.

NOTABLE: The 'without skill' agent for eval-1 (tasks disappearing) actually explored the codebase too (78k tokens, 12 tool uses) and found the exact BUG-1211 kill chain. This suggests the codebase context (CLAUDE.md) already provides enough debugging context for this project.
